nodes.name: Means employed
nodes.description: The tool, weapon, platform or diplomatic instrument used to carry out the action, as explicitly named in the primary sources of eveidence. Examples: ballistic missile, naval drone, emergency session, press release.

nodes.name: Observed monetary mean
nodes.description: Observed group mean of a monetary outcome, interpreted with currency, price year and follow-up. It is not a between-group causal effect.
